verdict.rationale: llamafile documents a `--cli` mode that answers prompts from the command line and a `--server` mode exposing an HTTP server and API, with a server sandbox that only answers inbound connections. That makes it a terminal and server process rather than a GUI app, since the Web UI is just a browser page served over HTTP. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that it runs headless with no display, documented CI-pipeline usage or examples, and independent hands-on reports of headless server or CI deployment.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run the runtime headlessly with no GUI for use in servers or CI pipelines

citations.quote: If you add the `--cli` argument to a llamafile, you will run a CLI version of the model that answers to whatever you provide as a prompt
HTTP server, API, Web UI, slot, and server sandbox options.
the only networking the server can do is answer connections it received.
llamafile is the model, runtime, and server in one file.
